audit_forwarder_target.name: audit_forwarder_target
audit_forwarder_target.value: ("audit_forwarder"."kind" = 'webhook' and "audit_forwarder"."secret_id" is not null) or ("audit_forwarder"."kind" = 'syslog' and "audit_forwarder"."port" is not null)

certificate_issuer_kind.name: certificate_issuer_kind
certificate_issuer_kind.value: ("certificate"."issuer_kind" = 'acme' and "certificate"."acme_ca_id" is not null and "certificate"."acme_account_id" is not null and "certificate"."issuing_ca_id" is null) or ("certificate"."issuer_kind" = 'private_ca' and "certificate"."issuing_ca_id" is not null and "certificate"."acme_ca_id" is null and "certificate"."acme_account_id" is null)

certificate_profile_issuer_kind.name: certificate_profile_issuer_kind
certificate_profile_issuer_kind.value: ("certificate_profile"."issuer_kind" = 'acme' and "certificate_profile"."acme_ca_id" is not null and "certificate_profile"."issuing_ca_id" is null) or ("certificate_profile"."issuer_kind" = 'private_ca' and "certificate_profile"."issuing_ca_id" is not null and "certificate_profile"."acme_ca_id" is null)

dcv_rule_method.name: dcv_rule_method
dcv_rule_method.value: ("dcv_rule"."method" = 'direct' and "dcv_rule"."validation_zone_id" is null) or ("dcv_rule"."method" = 'delegated' and "dcv_rule"."validation_zone_id" is not null and "dcv_rule"."dns_provider_id" is null)

enrollment_profile_previous_shared_chall.name: enrollment_profile_previous_shared_challenge
enrollment_profile_previous_shared_chall.value: ("enrollment_profile"."previous_shared_challenge_id" is null) = ("enrollment_profile"."previous_shared_challenge_hash" is null) and ("enrollment_profile"."previous_shared_challenge_id" is null) = ("enrollment_profile"."previous_shared_challenge_expires_at" is null) and ("enrollment_profile"."previous_shared_challenge_id" is null or "enrollment_profile"."shared_challenge_id" is not null)

issuing_ca_revoked.name: issuing_ca_revoked
issuing_ca_revoked.value: ("issuing_ca"."status" = 'revoked') = ("issuing_ca"."revoked_at" is not null and "issuing_ca"."revocation_reason" is not null)

managed_certificate_issuer_kind.name: managed_certificate_issuer_kind
managed_certificate_issuer_kind.value: ("managed_certificate"."issuer_kind" = 'acme' and "managed_certificate"."acme_ca_id" is not null and "managed_certificate"."issuing_ca_id" is null) or ("managed_certificate"."issuer_kind" = 'private_ca' and "managed_certificate"."issuing_ca_id" is not null and "managed_certificate"."acme_ca_id" is null)

notice_recipient.name: notice_recipient
notice_recipient.value: "notice"."email" is not null or "notice"."channel_id" is not null

notification_channel_target.name: notification_channel_target
notification_channel_target.value: ("notification_channel"."kind" = 'email' and "notification_channel"."email" is not null) or ("notification_channel"."kind" = 'webhook' and "notification_channel"."secret_id" is not null)

private_ca_platform_root.name: private_ca_platform_root
private_ca_platform_root.value: "private_ca"."kind" <> 'platform_root' or ("private_ca"."root_certificate_pem" is not null and "private_ca"."root_key" is not null)

revocation_request_failure.name: revocation_request_failure
revocation_request_failure.value: ("revocation_request"."status" = 'failed') = ("revocation_request"."failure_code" is not null and "revocation_request"."failure_message" is not null and "revocation_request"."finished_at" is not null)
